arguments.summary: The jobs service is degraded with 1388 failed jobs in the backlog. The connection pool for pgbouncer was exhausted, leading to worker throughput of 0. Raising the ingress idle timeout and replacing the expired intermediate certificate resolved the 502s and certificate alert. Restarting the jobs service cleared the connection pool. The recent failed jobs were examined.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs and resolve it to prevent future failures. Monitor the jobs service and pgbouncer to ensure they remain healthy.
